CANDY-GREEN PATCHWORK HILLS: soft rounded hills quilted in bright green and buttercup-yellow fields, hedgerows like embroidery stitching, a winding cobalt river looping lazily between every crest, puffball trees dotting the tops, the hills themselves plump enough to look squeezable

THE LEANING PEAK: one tall crooked mountain tilting gently leftward, its summit crowned in snow heaped like a generous dollop of vanilla frosting, a spiral path ribboning its flank, wildflower meadows carpeting its wide rounded feet

MUSHROOM TOWER STACK: three wide-capped rock hoodoos stacked like a tower of pancakes, each cap rounder and spongier than the one below, soft moss blanketing every ledge, the topmost cap so perfectly round it looks frosted with velvet lichen

CRESCENT COVE CLIFFS: a smooth crescent bay edged in pastel chalk cliffs of rose and mint, a single sea stack rising from the shallows with a tuft of twisted trees perched on its flat top like a tiny hat

THE GLASS FALLS GORGE: a deep rounded gorge of amber sandstone, a waterfall tumbling down its centre that catches and bends light like liquid glass, fern-covered ledges stepping down both walls, the pool at the base glowing aquamarine from within

STRIPED DUNE SEA: a rolling ocean of soft rounded dunes in candy stripes of apricot, rose, and pale gold, each dune crest perfectly smooth, clumps of round-leafed succulents dotting the valleys between every swelling ridge

ROUND ISLAND WITH THE GREAT TREE: a perfectly circular island sitting in a glassy lake, its one enormous tree spreading branches wide enough to shelter the whole hilltop, mossy roots curling into the water like friendly arms reaching for the shore

SNOWY FROSTING PEAKS: twin rounded mountains side by side, each summit heaped in sparkling white snow that drips slightly over the edges like thick icing, pine forests in deep teal climbing their lower slopes in neat triangular rows

THE SPIRAL MOUNTAIN: a stout crooked peak with a spiral path that winds around it seven times from base to tip, each loop edged in low flowering hedges, the summit capped in a perfect swirl of snow as though piped by a pastry chef

HOODOO PANCAKE SPIRES: five slender hoodoo towers clustered together, each topped with a wide rounded cap of darker red rock, small ferns and trailing vines draping over every cap brim like decorative frills on a layer cake

GOLDEN PATCHWORK VALLEY HILLS: a row of plump rolling hills in alternating squares of golden wheat and deep green clover, a pale gravel road winding in gentle S-curves between them, a round puffball tree standing on every hill crest like a lollipop

THE GLOWING RIBBON GORGE: a narrow winding gorge with smooth curved walls of pale limestone, a bright waterfall pouring down one end and spreading into a glowing teal stream that follows every curve of the gorge floor, mosses glowing softly on the walls

PASTEL CLIFF BAY: a gentle crescent of beach cupped between two arms of soft lavender and peach-striped cliffs, the cliffs rounded at their tops and dotted with tufts of sea grass, a lone sea stack near the left arm wearing a crown of dwarf trees

TINY HILL VILLAGE ISLAND: a round island in a wide lake with a small hill at its centre, the hill ringed in terraced garden plots of green and amber, the island's shoreline edged in broad flat stones and low round hedges

CANDY STRIPE DUNE CRESTS: broad rounded dunes in soft bands of terracotta, butter yellow, and dusty pink, each crescent crest sharp and smooth, low spherical shrubs nestled in every hollow between the dunes like scattered pompoms

THE WOBBLY SUMMIT PEAK: a single mountain with a noticeably wobbly silhouette, its rocky flanks softened by dense rounded shrubs, a band of cherry-red wildflower meadow encircling it halfway up, the snow cap sitting slightly off-centre as though slipping

LAKESIDE ROUND ISLAND: a small perfectly oval island resting in a still lake, a single conical hill rising from its middle topped by one enormous round-canopied tree, the island's edge ringed in smooth pale stones and low flowering rushes

RIVER-BEND ROLLING HILLS: five soft hills in a gentle arc, each a different shade of candy green, a wide blue river looping in full round bends between them and back again, berry bushes in thick rounded clumps lining both riverbanks

THE TILTING TOWER PEAK: a tall thin mountain leaning dramatically to the right, its pointed top bent like a witch's hat in a breeze, a spiral ledge path climbing the lean, alpine flowers tucked into every crack of its pale grey stone

TRIPLE MUSHROOM CAP ROCKS: three round-capped rock towers of russet sandstone, each cap wider than the pillar below and curved like an upturned bowl, thick cushion moss covering every top surface, small ferns sprouting from the joints between cap and pillar

SPARKLING TWIN SNOWPEAKS: two plump rounded mountains standing very close together, their shared snowfield sparkling with embedded crystal minerals, forests of dark rounded conifers wrapping their lower halves like cosy scarves, the snow draped over their summits in thick even blankets

THE DEEP LIGHT GORGE: a wide curved gorge of rose-pink granite, a tall waterfall at its head catching the mineral-rich water into a pool that glows pale jade, layered fern terraces covering every horizontal ledge from top to bottom

SEA STACK TUFT BAY: a wide crescent bay flanked by soft white and blush-pink cliffs, two slender sea stacks rising close together just offshore, each topped with a dense bouquet of wind-shaped trees, low sea-thrift carpeting every cliff ledge in soft pink cushions

CLOVER HILL WINDING ROAD: four broad rolling hills covered entirely in deep green clover sprinkled with tiny white flowers, a red cobblestone road curving between them in wide loops, each hilltop bearing a single broad-canopied fruit tree heavy with round fruit

THE GREAT TREE ISLE: a round island in a turquoise mountain lake, its single ancient tree so wide that its canopy covers the entire island top, thick gnarled roots spreading across the surface and over the bank into the shallows, bark glowing faintly gold
